arguments.value: Judith Morgenstern Barzilay, born in 1944 in Russell, Kansas, is a judge of the U.S. Court of International Trade. She earned a B.A. from Wichita State University, an M.L.S. from Rutgers University School of Library and Information Science, and a J.D. from Rutgers School of Law–Newark. Her career included work as a high school teacher in Kansas and New Jersey, a librarian in New York and New Jersey, a law clerk for the Superior Court of New Jersey, private practice in New Jersey and New York City, service as a trial attorney in the U.S. Department of Justice’s International Trade Field Office, and several positions at Sony Electronics, including senior attorney, vice president of import-export operations, and vice president of government affairs. She also served on the Treasury Advisory Committee on Commercial Operations of the U.S. Customs Service.
